correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=2, the nonspoke matching subcomplex is the join of n copies of an interval plus isolated point and has integral sphere homology. Each of the 2n spoke links is a join of n two-component spaces, its inclusion induces a unit on top integral homology, and distinct spoke cones intersect only in the base. The resulting equivariant relative long exact sequence is exactly 0 -> H_n -> theta tensor Z[W] -> theta -> 0. Blade reversals act trivially on each local reduced H0; blade permutations act with the join-orientation sign. Consequently the full integral group module, all other homology vanishings, and character formula follow for all n. Independent exact finite signed Lefschetz checks verify 440 elements n=2,3,4 and 20 samples n=5; mod-two boundary reductions check ranks. The finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural full graph automorphism action on an infinite family of canonical pentagonal bouquets is specified over the integers, capturing local blade reversals entirely absent from the known subgroup character. The kernel-lattice description computes all traces and sharp fixed-subspace dimensions for the local-reflection and full groups, providing more than an ordinary Betti number or known restricted character. The result is structurally motivated by the canonical set of central spokes and has a usable equivariant chain-sequence proof.
